<a id="summary"></a>

## Summary

Context brief. Purpose: turn the POC Claude prep into product code behind sealed core::prep v2 ports (assets/impl-guide.dd.md architecture.contracts). Entrypoints: `unisphere prep` (crates/app/src/main.rs → crates/app/src/prep.rs), unisphere_sdk::prep::{Preparer, fold_source}, ClaudePrepFold, FileSessionLoader as PrepLoader, ParquetPrepStore. Dependencies: tk-0001 seals before any dispatch; tk-0002…tk-0005 run in parallel clones and import no sibling implementation; tk-0006 imports in order tk-0003, tk-0004, tk-0002, tk-0005. Test approach: pure fold on synthetic fixtures; engine with testkit RecordingFold/MemoryLoader/MemoryPrepStore; store on temp dirs read back through the Parquet Arrow reader; CLI with a fake PrepApi; assembled behaviour through unisphere-proof prep. Hazards: reference-parser window/gap-rounding semantics (re-measure, never round away), state.json growth, same-size same-mtime rewrites, concurrent writers, content leakage into fixtures or evidence. Required proof: vd-0001…vd-0009, vd-000a, vd-000b, vd-0016, vd-0015 per the guide; real-corpus runs only under .harness/temp/prep-real.
